name: Internet provider: shares an outage ETA from an internal note, without the private details
description: An internal note tracks a live outage: the area, the ETA, and a contractor that must not be named. A customer in that area reports no internet. The draft must give the ETA, keep the contractor private, and cite the note for the reviewer.

input.subject: No internet
input.body: My internet in Northfield has been down since this morning. When will it be back?

knowledge.title: Outage: Northfield (internal)
knowledge.content: Northfield outage since 08:00. Cause: fibre cut by our contractor Brightline Civil during roadworks. Fix expected by 18:00 today. Tell customers we know about it and give the 18:00 estimate. Do not name the contractor.

knowledge.title: Restarting your router
knowledge.content: Unplug the router for 30 seconds, then plug it back in. Wait 2 minutes for the lights to turn green.

mock.text:
Hi Noor, sorry about the trouble. We know about an outage affecting Northfield, and we expect service to be back by 18:00 today. There's no need to do anything on your side; it should come back on its own.

Best,
Support
[sources: K1]
